source_name: НБУ — Статистика (головний розділ статистики) / NBU Statistics hub
why_relevant: Top-level entry point of the NBU statistical publishing system; branches to monetary/financial, supervisory, external-sector, macro and payment-related statistics. Mirrored in English at /en/statistic. Almost every downstream UA payments statistic traces back here.

source_name: NBU — Statistics at the National Bank of Ukraine (methodology / statistical programme overview)
why_relevant: Describes what economic and financial data the NBU compiles, for what purpose, and which user groups it serves — a map of the whole statistical output, useful to enumerate datasets before collecting them.

source_name: НБУ — Безготівкові розрахунки / NBU Cashless Payments (card, ATM, POS statistics section)
why_relevant: The single most on-target page for this run: NBU publishes here the key data on number of clients, payment cards, ATMs and POS terminals, plus transaction counts/values broken down by payment system and by network, with downloadable files and infographics. English mirror at /en/payments/nocash.

source_name: НБУ — Платежі та розрахунки / NBU Payments and Settlements (section hub)
why_relevant: Parent hub linking cashless statistics, oversight, payment-system registers, SEP (electronic payment system) statistics and regulatory pages — the navigation spine for all payment-infrastructure data at the NBU.

source_name: НБУ — прес-релізи про ринок платіжних карток (news/all quarterly card-market releases)
why_relevant: Recurring quarterly narrative releases with headline numbers: POS terminal counts, ATM counts, trade-and-service outlets accepting cards, cashless share by count and by value. These are the texts that all Ukrainian media re-quote, and they carry the interpretation the raw XLSX does not.

source_name: НБУ — Грошово-кредитна та фінансова статистика (monthly MFS bulletin, PDF series)
why_relevant: Monthly monetary and financial statistics release; the authoritative series for готівка в обігу (cash in circulation), M0-M3 monetary aggregates and banking-sector balance-sheet aggregates. Predictable file-naming pattern MFS_YYYY-MM.pdf makes it trivially harvestable as a time series.

source_name: НБУ — Методологічний коментар: Грошово-кредитна статистика
why_relevant: The methodology note behind the monetary/financial statistics: definitions, sector coverage (100% of banks operating in Ukraine), compilation and dissemination frequency. Essential to avoid mis-reading cash-in-circulation and aggregate series, and to justify comparisons over time.

source_name: Бюлетень Національного банку України (електронне видання) — stat.pdf
why_relevant: Consolidated NBU statistical bulletin covering monetary-policy indicators and monetary/credit statistics in one recurring document at a stable URL; convenient single-file baseline for macro/banking context around payment data.

source_name: НБУ — Наглядова статистика / NBU Supervisory Statistics
why_relevant: Key indicators of the banking sector and of individual licensed banks, plus indicators for non-bank financial market participants (NBU has supervised them since 1 July 2020 under Law 79-IX). Provides the bank-by-bank denominator for any card/terminal market-share work.

source_name: NBU — Financial Sector Statistics
why_relevant: English-language financial-sector statistical section covering banks and non-bank institutions; the practical entry point when uk-language parsing is not available and for cross-checking terminology between the uk and en editions.

source_name: NBU — Macroeconomic Indicators
why_relevant: NBU-curated macro series (compiled with the State Statistics Service and State Treasury) used for monetary decisions — provides GDP, inflation and household-income denominators needed to normalise card/ATM/POS volumes.

source_name: НБУ OpenData REST API — NBUStatService /v1/statdirectory
why_relevant: Machine-readable API exposing NBU open-data blocks and reference directories in XML/JSON (exchange rates, UIIR, statistical-reporting dimensions and report schemas). The cleanest programmatic ingestion path into NBU data and the right foundation for an automated collector.

source_name: НБУ — Реєстр показників статистичної звітності / Register of Statistical Reporting Indicators
why_relevant: The metadata layer: which indicator files banks and non-bank institutions must submit to the NBU, with file specifications. Reveals what payment/card/terminal data exists inside the NBU even when it is not published, and lets you map published aggregates back to their reporting forms.

source_name: Data.gov.ua — розпорядник "Національний банк України" (NBU open-data publisher page)
why_relevant: Ukraine's national open-data portal lists the NBU's registered datasets — including payment cards in Ukraine, cashless settlements via payment terminals, payment infrastructure, card operations, economic-standards values and bank statistical-reporting indicator registers. CKAN-backed, so it offers a stable API and format/licence filtering that bank.gov.ua does not.

source_name: НБУ — Звіт з оверсайту платіжної інфраструктури (Oversight Report series)
why_relevant: Annual oversight report on payment systems, settlement systems and payment-infrastructure service operators: registered payment systems counts, systemically important systems, SEP volumes, and criteria for significant infrastructure operators. Contains structural detail on the payment infrastructure that the quarterly card releases omit.

source_name: НБУ — Оверсайт інфраструктур фінансового ринку (section) + реєстр платіжної інфраструктури
why_relevant: Hub for oversight of financial market infrastructures; links the registers of payment systems, payment-system participants and payment-infrastructure service operators — the actor map for who actually runs ATM/POS acquiring and processing in Ukraine.

source_name: НБУ — Огляд банківського сектору / Banking Sector Review (quarterly PDF series)
why_relevant: Quarterly analytical review of the banking sector with commission/fee income, net assets, and cash-flow seasonality — the context layer that explains why card and terminal volumes move. Predictable Banking_Sector_Review_YYYY-MM.pdf naming supports time-series harvesting.

source_name: НБУ — Річний звіт / NBU Annual Report (PDF series)
why_relevant: Annual report consolidates payment-infrastructure development indicators, cash-circulation operations and financial-inclusion measures into audited, citable year-end figures — a reliable backstop when quarterly series are revised, and it carries strategy signals (e.g. cash-at-checkout, inclusion banks).

source_name: НБУ — Форум з фінансової інклюзії (financial inclusion portal)
why_relevant: Dedicated NBU subdomain for financial inclusion: survey findings and indicators on access to and usage of financial services, remote vs branch/cash behaviour, and branch cash-operation load. Directly relevant to cash-usage and terminal-acceptance demand analysis, and a source of NBU survey microdata not present in the main statistics section.

source_name: NBU — Financial Stability Report
why_relevant: Semi-annual NBU flagship on sector risk; includes bank profitability drivers (notably fee-and-commission income from card and acquiring business) and sector concentration — useful for interpreting payment-market structure rather than raw counts.

source_name: НБУ — портал portal.bank.gov.ua (REST API technical instructions / statistical portal)
why_relevant: Separate NBU portal subdomain hosting REST API v.1.1 technical instructions; indicates a second, portal-based data delivery channel distinct from bank.gov.ua/NBUStatService and worth probing for additional statistical endpoints.

source_name: Ukrstat mirror of NBU SDDS metadata (ukrstat.gov.ua/imf/nbu.htm and /imf/meta/)
why_relevant: State Statistics Service hosts IMF SDDS-style metadata pages describing NBU-produced categories (central bank survey 'огляд ЦБ', international reserves, exchange rate). Useful as an independent description of NBU data definitions and release calendars, and as a fallback when bank.gov.ua is blocked.

source_name: Мінфін (index.minfin.com.ua) — Основні показники діяльності банків
why_relevant: Long-running commercial re-publisher of NBU banking statistics in cleaned, time-series HTML tables. Not authoritative, but a fast cross-check and a fallback when bank.gov.ua blocks automated access; also flags which NBU indicators are considered market-relevant.

source_name: Асоціація українських банків (АУБ) — банківські новини, ретрансляція статистики НБУ
why_relevant: Banking-industry association that re-publishes NBU card/terminal statistics with industry framing; useful as an early-warning feed for NBU releases and to see which NBU numbers the banking industry itself amplifies.

source_name: Державна служба статистики України (Держстат) — новий офіційний портал
why_relevant: National statistical office; publishes the statistical observation plan, retail trade turnover, household income/expenditure, ICT access and enterprise ICT surveys — the general-economy denominators against which payment and cash indicators are normalised. Distinct publication duty from the NBU.

source_name: Держстат — Development API (машиночитний доступ до статистики)
why_relevant: Machine-readable access route to Держстат series; the preferred long-term collection channel for recurring statistical indicators instead of PDF statistical yearbooks.

source_name: Держстат — legacy archive ukrstat.gov.ua (публікації, методологія, форми звітності)
why_relevant: Holds the deep historical archive of statistical publications, methodological provisions and reporting forms (1-торг, 3-торг) not fully migrated to stat.gov.ua; needed for time series predating the site migration.
